President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has expressed his support for anti-corruption rallies that will take place on Sunday, September 21, Malacañang said.

Thousands of people are expected to troop to Rizal Park and EDSA People Power Monument to protest the corruption in government infrastructure projects, particularly those involving flood control. Protests were also planned in the provinces.

Today, September 21, Filipinos are gathering in EDSA and Luneta to stand united against corruption, injustice, and government mismanagement. From Luzon to Visayas to Mindanao, we call for transparency and accountability.

We support the cause. We support the protest. We support every Filipino who dares to demand change. 🇵🇭 Let’s raise our voice with hope.

📍 If you’ll join the protest: know your rights, bring essentials, stay safe.

In solidarity with the movement, we will not be posting anything after this as our way of support.

#TrillionPesoMarch #BahaSaLuneta

RESTRICTED AREA MUNA

Itinalaga muna bilang temporary restricted area ng Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) ang Luneta Park sa Maynila at EDSA Shrine sa Quezon City bilang bahagi ng seguridad sa malawakang anti-corruption rallies ngayong Linggo, Sept. 21.

Ibig sabihin, bawal munang lumipad ang kahit anong eroplano o unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) sa loob ng 15-nautical mile radius mula sa sentro ng dalawang venue ng mga rally.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Typhoon NANDO
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 21 September 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Quezon within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Metro Manila, Cavite, Tarlac(San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao, Angeles, Guagua, Macabebe, Masantol, Sasmuan, Mabalacat), Bulacan(Hagonoy, Paombong, Malolos, Bulakan, Meycauayan, Obando, Marilao, Bocaue, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Santa Maria, San Jose del Monte), Bataan(Morong, Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Orani, Samal), Laguna(San Pedro, Binan, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba), Rizal(Rodriguez, San Mateo, Antipolo, Teresa, Angono, Taytay, Cainta, Binangonan, Morong, Cardona, Baras) and Batangas(Laurel, Nasugbu, Tuy, Lemery, Calaca, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
